stdout:
Build kit for "empty state"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        library
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template library --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: ai-chat-landing (@astryxdesign/core), library (@astryxdesign/core), blank (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        EmptyStateShowcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A no-results empty state with an icon, descriptive message, and a call-to-action button.

name:        EmptyStateContainer
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding.

name:        EmptyStateCompact
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        EmptyState
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data.

name:        useTableSortableState
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Owns a Table's sort state and sorts the rows locally, as a convenience layer over useTableSortable.

name:        Center
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container.
